purpose: Ketotifen is used to relieve itchy, red, and watery eyes caused by allergies. It works quickly to stop the uncomfortable itching you get from things like pollen, pet dander, or dust. It is available as eye drops for eye allergy relief and as a tablet or syrup in some countries for general allergy symptoms.
how_it_works: Your body releases a chemical called histamine when it encounters something you are allergic to, and that histamine is what makes your eyes itch and water. Ketotifen blocks histamine from doing its job, so you feel less itchy and irritated. It also helps stabilize certain cells in your body so they release less of that irritating histamine in the first place.
common_side_effects: The eye drop form may cause mild temporary stinging or burning right after you put the drops in. Some people notice slightly blurry vision for a moment after using the drops. The oral form, used in some countries, can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, or increased appetite.
warnings: Do not wear contact lenses while your eyes are red or irritated. If you use contact lenses, wait at least 10 minutes after putting in the eye drops before putting your contacts back in. Do not use the eye drops if you are allergic to any ingredient in the product. If your eye symptoms do not improve after a few days or get worse, check with your doctor. Keep the bottle tip clean and avoid touching it to your eye.
typical_dosing: For the eye drops, the usual dose is one drop in the affected eye or eyes twice a day, about 8 to 12 hours apart. Do not use more drops than recommended. The oral form dosing varies by country and age, so always follow your doctor or pharmacist's specific instructions.
